description: This file defines types, utility functions, and plugin registration mechanisms for channel-related plugins in a messaging or communication system. It includes functions for creating adapters, resolving configurations, and building session routes, as well as plugin entry definitions.

methods.name: createInlineTextPairingAdapter
methods.description: Creates a ChannelPairingAdapter with specified notification message and allow entry normalization.

methods.name: createInlineAttachedChannelResultAdapter
methods.description: Creates an adapter to send text, media, or poll messages attached to a specific channel.

methods.name: resolveChatChannelSecurity
methods.description: Resolves and constructs a ChannelSecurityAdapter from various security options.

methods.name: resolveChatChannelPairing
methods.description: Resolves and constructs a ChannelPairingAdapter from pairing options.

methods.name: resolveChatChannelThreading
methods.description: Resolves and constructs a ChannelThreadingAdapter from threading options.

methods.name: resolveChatChannelOutbound
methods.description: Resolves and constructs a ChannelOutboundAdapter from outbound options.

methods.name: defineChannelPluginEntry
methods.description: Defines a channel plugin entry with registration logic and configuration schema.

methods.name: defineSetupPluginEntry
methods.description: Wraps a plugin for setup purposes.

methods.name: stripChannelTargetPrefix
methods.description: Removes specified provider prefixes from a raw channel target string.

methods.name: stripTargetKindPrefix
methods.description: Removes common target kind prefixes from a raw string.

methods.name: buildChannelOutboundSessionRoute
methods.description: Builds a session route object for outbound channel communication.

methods.name: createChatChannelPlugin
methods.description: Creates a chat channel plugin with optional security, pairing, threading, and outbound configurations.
